source_text.body:
Count real estate listings by subtracting filter results
ChatGPT Agent Mode counted Trulia listings in Florida with exactly three bathrooms by subtracting the 'four or more' count from 'three or more'; the team stepped in for a bot check.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The team switched on Agent Mode by typing /agent, then gave it a short prompt with the Trulia Florida URL, asking for the total count of homes with 3 baths. The agent opened a virtual browser and reached the filters on its own. It found no exact-three filter, so it pulled the 'three or more' and 'four or more' counts and subtracted. When Trulia ran a verification check, a team member completed it and handed control back.
How it went
The agent finished the task and produced the exactly-three-bathroom count after the handoff. The article doesn't state the actual number. The recorded session ran 8.5 minutes.
Worth knowing
Expect a bot-verification check mid-run, so someone needs to be watching to complete it. The session took about 8.5 minutes for one count.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Go to [real estate site, e.g. Trulia] and find how many listings in [state or city] have exactly [number] bathrooms. Do it by running the search with '[number] or more' and again with '[number+1] or more', then subtracting the second count from the first. Report both counts, the result, and the filters you used, and stop there. If a bot check or login appears, pause and ask me to take over.
Original source: https://accelstone.com/articles/how-to-use-chatgpt-agent-mode-to-handle-online-tasks-with-its-own-virtual-desktop/
